mapper.insert: INSERT INTO knowledge_document ( title, content, knowledge_scope, source_type, venue_id, venue_name, court_id, court_name, court_type, notice_id, topic, tags, priority, enabled, indexed_status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{content}, #{knowledgeScope}, #{sourceType}, #{venueId}, #{venueName}, #{courtId}, #{courtName}, #{courtType}, #{noticeId}, #{topic}, #{tags}, #{priority}, 1, 0, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT id, title, content, knowledge_scope AS knowledgeScope, source_type AS sourceType, venue_id AS venueId, venue_name AS venueName, court_id AS courtId, court_name AS courtName, court_type AS courtType, notice_id AS noticeId, topic, tags, priority, enabled, indexed_status AS indexedStatus, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM knowledge_document WHERE enabled = 1 ORDER BY priority DESC, id ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE knowledge_document SET indexed_status = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
